pure_power_class.class_verdict: NONE, including beyond the finite exponent box
pure_power_class.exact_reason: After squaring, K*c^2*n^(1+2a)*(n-1)*(n+1)=1/n. The irreducible factors n-1 and n+1 have exponent 1 on the left and exponent 0 on the right; varying a or c cannot remove them.

local_polynomial_class.claim: No nonzero finite polynomial multiplier P(n) gives K*n*(n^2-1)*P(n)^2=1/n for all n>=2.
local_polynomial_class.reason: If deg(P)=m>=0, the left side grows as a nonzero constant times n^(3+2m), while 1/n decays.
